title.text: Three-stage advancement can complete the transformation within twelve months

source_anchors.text: The three-phase advancement can complete the transformation within twelve months. Three-stage advancement can complete the transformation within twelve months
The first phase is to diagnose the current situation and form a problem list, which lasts from January to March. Diagnosis; Diagnosis status; Create a list of questions

After completing the diagnosis, it will enter the second phase of the pilot to verify the core process and deliver the pilot report, which lasts from April to August. Pilot report; Verify core process

After the pilot is passed, it will enter the third phase of promotion, complete the system solidification and all employees go online, and the cycle will be from September to December. Complete system solidification; All members are online
Track risks, resources and quantitative indicators throughout the entire process. Resources; Quantitative indicators
